chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang, severed in half, kills the Spite-Blight with a coin sword but faces a new threat: a woman with incense through her skull and an Office token that might be a lie.
og_title: Chapter 480 – The Corpse Under the Smoke
og_description: Li Huowang crawls as a torso, battles black malice, and meets a stranger who may be from the Office.
twitter_title: Chapter 480 – Severed Bait in the Peach Grove
twitter_description: Li Huowang cuts himself in half to trap the Spite-Blight, but a new woman with incense in her skull walks into frame.

lore_anchors.definition: A malevolent entity in the Dao-Twisted World that possesses living bodies; its corpse produces black smoke that amplifies a person’s inner darkness with hate, murderous intent, and irritability.
A Daoist ritual weapon made of coins strung on red cord. Used for exorcism; it can pin and kill entities like the Spite-Blight.
A twisted expansion of Buddhist doctrine used in the Dao-Twisted World; Li Huowang reads this in others to tell whether their face matches their heart.
A government-sponsored supernatural law enforcement body. Operatives accept jobs on a competitive, first-completed basis.
A fictional sect fusing Zoroastrian and Nestorian imagery; its members use self-mutilation and pain-rituals for power. Li Huowang belongs to it.
A spiked mace; in ritual contexts, it is often wrapped with talisman paper as a weapon against evil spirits.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why couldn’t Li Huowang’s hand touch the Spite-Blight’s corpse but a rotten stick could?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The narration implies that living flesh is somehow repelled or nullified by the entity’s nature, but inanimate matter is not. This may be a rule of Spite-Blight physics.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the fat woman really from the Supervisory Heavenly Office?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Her token matches. Her emotional reading from Li Huowang suggests she is hiding something, but her Office identity is not challenged in this chapter.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the job reward for catching a Spite-Blight?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Hundreds of lifespan pills (阳寿丹), which are extremely valuable in the Dao-Twisted World.
